title: Become a member — accept
description: Open the Accept link from email, set a password and score PIN, and activate membership.

steps.title: Accept membership
steps.body: The Accept link in email opens this setup page. It is valid for 7 days.

steps.title: Set password and PIN
steps.body: Choose a password (club minimum length) and a 4-digit score PIN used at the kiosk.
steps.actionHint: Fill password and PIN, then Activate

steps.title: Ready to activate
steps.body: Activate and sign in creates the account and signs you in. After that you can add phone, photo, and notification preferences.
steps.resultNote: Password and PIN are filled; Activate is ready. (This walkthrough does not submit, so the demo token stays valid.)
